title: accumarray
summary: Accumulate values into an array by subscript groups.

gpu_support.notes: Grouped accumulation runs on the host.

description: `accumarray(subs,data)` groups entries of `data` by one-based subscripts in `subs` and sums each group into the corresponding output element.
behaviors: Supports vector, matrix, and cell-vector subscripts. Positive subscripts and explicit positive sizes accept every integer class and are bounds-checked without conversion through binary64.

Integer data is scalar-expanded or grouped in its native class. The default `@sum` form returns double, while an explicit group function receives native-class column vectors and determines the output class; an integer fill value must match that returned class.

Sparse output is 2-D and double-only for input data and group results, requires an omitted or double-zero fill, and rejects typed-integer data or fill values. The `issparse` control accepts only logical or numeric `0` or `1`.
Grouped accumulation runs on the host. Inputs are gathered from an acceleration provider, and the documented GPU-array form rejects integer data and fill values.
